title: Lattice recovery for the Bauer-linked quadratic congruential generator
summary: Determine whether the source MIHNP/ICG lattice method extends to state recovery for the geometrically linked quadratic congruential generator.

formal_statement.body: For the quadratic congruential generator linked geometrically to the source inversive congruential generator in Bauer et al., under a compatible partial-output leakage model, give and prove a lattice-based state-recovery attack with explicit leakage, sample, success-probability, and complexity bounds, or prove that the source technique cannot apply.

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of quadratic congruential generators
assumptions: The generator and geometric link are those of Bauer et al., Section 3.4
The leakage model is compatible with the source ICG analysis
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later result analyzes the Bauer-linked quadratic generator with the source leakage and recovery predicate.

progress.summary: The source asks whether its ICG technique can analyze and recover the state of the geometrically linked quadratic generator.
